scope: Behavior-preserving architecture cleanup of PR155; gameplay specification unchanged.

findings.finding: Movement unlocks, walk budget and cooldown were repeated across planning and execution.
findings.resolution: enemy-position.js owns shared rules and capability/budget queries. BossActions and Engine consume those queries.

findings.finding: Teleport future-landing validity was repeated in candidate planning and application.
findings.resolution: Both boundaries call one landingFuture function; application revalidation remains.

findings.finding: Progression search/forecast behavior and score thresholds were partly embedded in evaluation code.
findings.resolution: Frozen progression table and shared policy settings are owned by enemy-position.js.

retainedBoundaries: EnemyActions owns real ballistic evaluation and the shared synchronous/cooperative planning generator.
Normal and boss physical movement remain distinct because boss armor and floating collision need their existing handling; both use Position.walkLegal.
Existing boss40/60 armor gates and final-field mechanics are preserved, not new map-specific spacing exceptions.

equivalence.note: Canonical full-state movement and complete shot-plan hashes; planning also asserts the live input state remains unchanged.

limits: 123 sampled conditions are not proof of equivalence for every random seed and every reachable game state.
Automated tests do not establish long-term maintainability, all-map play balance or physical-device performance.
No new generic AI framework, per-enemy behavior configuration or map exceptions were added.
